## CarbonFlow ESG Data Extraction

This workflow processes utility bills (electricity, water, fuel) using an AI Agent to extract consumption data and calculates total CO2e emissions via the Climatiq API. It automatically handles physical units and uses spend-based fallbacks (e.g., JOD) when consumption volume is missing.

**Frontend Dashboard**
If you are looking for the user interface that connects to this workflow, you can find the repository here:
